entries.text: Newcomers landed: 8 Ruropo came ashore from elsewhere.
The Ruropo are the island's first hunters.
Hard times for the Maleha: only 29 are left of 59.
The Malenu split from the Maleha.
The Maleno multiply: 70 now, 26 a month ago.
Among the Maleno, a group grew apart: the Malela.
The Malebe split from the Maleno.
